visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium supplement ad recreating the exact layout of the attached reference composition. Background: smooth vertical gradient from bubblegum pink (#FF8CC0) to hot fuchsia (#E6177F) with pale blush highlights and soft translucent pink petal and heart shapes in the top corners. TOP (upper 30%, centered): a rounded deep-magenta (#B0105E) pill banner containing the first headline line in white heavy uppercase sans-serif; directly below, the second headline line in large white heavy uppercase with a soft drop shadow; below it, the third line as the largest text on the canvas, heavy uppercase hot fuchsia (#E6177F) with a thick white outline and soft 3D drop shadow. MIDDLE (55%): on the far left a narrow vertical column of three white-outlined circles with thin-line white icons — a stylized female buttocks outline with a small up arrow, a pair of legs, and a leaf — each with a two-line bold uppercase deep-magenta label below. In the center-left stands the hero product, large and upright, facing the camera: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle; the black label shows a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner, a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA', and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it, keep its label text and colors identical. At the lower-left base of the bottle, a small cluster of real aguaje fruits with scaly reddish-brown skin, one halved to show bright orange flesh, with a few fresh green leaves. Above the bottle to the right of the cap, a short handwritten deep-magenta script phrase with a small heart. On the right half, a tall rounded-corner photo card with a thin white border: an ultra-photorealistic young Latina woman seen from behind, framed from waist to mid-thigh, wearing a fitted fuchsia textured athletic short and a black top, natural athletic curves in glutes and thighs, real skin texture, bright soft indoor daylight, tasteful and non-explicit. The bottle slightly overlaps the left edge of the photo card. BOTTOM (lower 12%): on the left two-thirds, a rounded deep-magenta bar with a white delivery-truck icon and white bold uppercase text, a thin white vertical divider, then a white hand-holding-coin icon and white bold uppercase text. To the right of the bar, a two-line handwritten deep-magenta script phrase with a small heart. Only the listed texts appear. No other logos, prices, badges, stars or extra text.
